69d8dc6bf1921eeb784e3e74 description:
I’ve seen this pattern before. When supply lines stop being visible, it means someone is controlling them.

Not traders. Not scavs. Someone organized.

That data you’ve been pulling — the same material Skier is sniffing around — it’s not just numbers. It’s routes. Timing. Movement discipline. That’s logistics.

I don’t care who built the system. I care where it moves and how to break it.

You build me a proper extract from those records — something I can act on — and I’ll turn it into intercepted cargo, broken routes, and dead operators.
